# License Headers (Required for All Files)

## PHP Files

Add immediately after `<?php` with NO blank line before or after:

```php
<?php
/**
 * 2010-2026 2win.agency
 *
 * NOTICE OF LICENSE
 *
 * This file is not open source! Each license that you purchased is only available for 1 wesite only.
 * If you want to use this file on more websites (or projects), you need to purchase additional licenses.
 * You are not allowed to redistribute, resell, lease, license, sub-license or offer our resources to any third party.
 *
 * DISCLAIMER
 *
 * Do not edit or add to this file if you wish to upgrade PrestaShop to newer
 * versions in the future. If you wish to customize PrestaShop for your
 * needs please contact us for extra customization service at an affordable price
 *
 * @author    2win.agency
 * @copyright 2010-2026 2win.agency
 * @license   Valid for 1 website (or project) for each purchase of license
 *            International Registered Trademark & Property of 2win.agency
 */
if (!defined('_PS_VERSION_')) {
    exit;
}
```

**Critical**: NO blank line between `*/` and code. Use 4-space alignment for `@author`, `@copyright`, `@license`.

## TPL Files

Add at very beginning with NO blank line:

```smarty
{*
 * 2010-2026 2win.agency
 *
 * NOTICE OF LICENSE
 *
 * This file is not open source! Each license that you purchased is only available for 1 wesite only.
 * If you want to use this file on more websites (or projects), you need to purchase additional licenses.
 * You are not allowed to redistribute, resell, lease, license, sub-license or offer our resources to any third party.
 *
 * DISCLAIMER
 *
 * Do not edit or add to this file if you wish to upgrade PrestaShop to newer
 * versions in the future. If you wish to customize PrestaShop for your
 * needs please contact us for extra customization service at an affordable price
 *
 * @author    2win.agency
 * @copyright 2010-2026 2win.agency
 * @license   Valid for 1 website (or project) for each purchase of license
 *            International Registered Trademark & Property of 2win.agency
 *}
```

## index.php Files

Special case for security redirect files:

```php
<?php
/**
 * 2010-2026 2win.agency
 *
 * ... (same license content) ...
 *
 * @author    2win.agency
 * @copyright 2010-2026 2win.agency
 * @license   Valid for 1 website (or project) for each purchase of license
 *            International Registered Trademark & Property of 2win.agency
 */
header('Expires: Mon, 26 Jul 1997 05:00:00 GMT');
header('Last-Modified: ' . gmdate('D, d M Y H:i:s') . ' GMT');
header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate');
header('Cache-Control: post-check=0, pre-check=0', false);
header('Pragma: no-cache');
header('Location: ../');
exit;
```
